name: Log drum (talking walk)
desc: A talkative log drum: a longer, gliding penv and a resonant, ringing filter give each note a vocal quality, and the line walks melodically through D minor (d-f-a-c) rather than just bouncing octaves. Punchy midbass, Dm-Dm-Bb-A. Full is a rolling walk with a filter tide and phrase fills; peak doubles the subdivision and floats an octave ghost over the top.

glide.doc: penv glide depth in semitones (the talking bend)

res.doc: lpq resonance - the vocal/talking formant peak

code.full: note("<[d2 ~ d2 f2 ~ a2 ~ d3] [d2 ~ d2 f2 ~ a2 c3 d3] [bb2 ~ bb2 d3 ~ f2 ~ bb2] [a2 ~ a2 c3 ~ e3 ~ a2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").penv(${glide}).pdec(.14).attack(.002).decay(.55).sustain(.18).release(.26).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.55, ${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).lpq(${res}).shape(.5).gain(${gain}).room(.12).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[d2 f2 d2 f2 a2 c3 a2 d3] [d2 f2 d2 f2 a2 c3 d3 e3] [bb2 d3 bb2 d3 f2 a2 f2 bb2] [a2 c3 a2 c3 e2 g2 e2 a2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").penv(${glide}).pdec(.12).attack(.002).decay(.45).sustain(.14).release(.2).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}*1.5).slow(16)).lpq(${res}).shape(.5).gain(${gain}).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.35)).orbit(3).play()
